Round-4 repair complete.

## P13A — one versioned schema, isolated-worktree capture

Immutable top level written once (`schema`, `schema_version: 1`, `spec_id`, `base_sha`, `canonical_commands`, `captures: []`) — the contradictory top-level `commands` array and `git_status_clean` are removed and explicitly declared absent. `captures[]` is append-only and **its first entry is the initial capture**; every entry, initial and regenerated alike, carries `capture_id`, `regenerated`, `reason` (null initially), `base_sha`, `worktree` evidence, `setup` (the in-worktree `bun install --frozen-lockfile`), `commands[]` with exact strings/status/duration/counts/enumerated failures/log sha256+path, `environment`, timestamps, and `planning_worktree_state`.

The **initial** capture now runs in an isolated detached worktree at the exact base SHA — identical in shape to regeneration. Cleanliness is asserted there only; the planning worktree's dirt is recorded as evidence, asserted free of product-path changes, and never required clean. Capture-before-change ordering, append-only regeneration, and `capture_id` citation preserved.

## P14 — identical baseline and final command sets

One canonical baseline-compared list, shared verbatim by spec R17, task .2's `canonical_commands`, and task .7's final gate: `bun run lint:check`, `bunx tsc --noEmit`, `bun test` (full — replacing the `test/serve/` subset), `bun run test:web`, `bun run docs:verify`. Task .7 diffs each command's failures against that same command's enumerated list in the cited capture. Everything outside the list — new tests, `test:e2e:pdf`, `test:package`, P-1…P-6 — is defined consistently as absolute-pass and never baseline-compared. Tasks .1/.3–.6 keep focused subsets, checked against the CBC command containing them.

## Files touched

Spec MD, task .2 MD, task .7 MD, plus `.flow/reviews/fn-112-opus-plan-revision-p13a-p14.{md,json}`. No spec JSON, no task JSON, no prior receipt modified. P1–P13/N1–N15 frozen.
